changeSet.author: osmontero
changeSet.comment: Standardized v11-alert-* OpenSearch mappings (installer/services/search.go) pin severityLabel, statusLabel, statusObservation, and id as bare keyword fields without a .keyword multifield. Rewrite alert visualizations so their filters, aggregations, and cached queries reference the bare keyword paths, and align viz 500 (Close Windows Alert Count) with AlertStatus.COMPLETED ("Completed").
